page.overview:
Who is Blaze the Cat?

Blaze the Cat is a cat princess from the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise. introduced to the series in Sonic Rush. Blaze first appears alongside Mario characters in Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games for the Wii.

Blaze has can spawn and control fire, a skill known as pyrokinesis.

Blaze was originally withdrawn and aloof until she met Cream the Rabbit, whom she learned the meaning and value of friendship from, along with Sonic and Tails.

Typically, Blaze is serious, quiet, and not too good at making friends. She takes her job very seriously, to a somewhat unhealthy extent. However, Blaze has a strong sense of justice.
